judgments.rewrite_hint: 該当箇所: “Through Muse, trained human contract workers made some calls and completed the exchanges with users.” 「with users」を、電話をかけた相手とのやり取りだと分かる表現に狭めてください（例: “with the people they called”）。参照: MUSE-HC-006.

該当箇所: “the user’s sensitive information might be shared with contract workers at a call center. One helper meant one more person handling private data.” 実際に情報を扱ったと断定せず、従業員の懸念として可能性を保つ表現にしてください（例: “Employees worried that a helper could mean one more person might see sensitive information.”）。参照: MUSE-HC-010.
